populate_operationruns_from_csv: insert into operationruns select _key,index,tick,opcode,size,bank,addr,cast(val as uint128) as val,raw,assocd_addr,assocd_bank,assocd_size from  read_csv('out/deltas.csv',delim=',',columns={'_key':'varchar','runid':'uint64','index':'uint64','tick':'uint64','opcode':'uint64','bank':'uint64','addr':'uint64','val':'varchar','raw':'varchar','size':'uint64','assocd_bank':'uint64','assocd_addr':'uint64','assocd_size':'uint64'},strict_mode=false,header=true,null_padding=true,ignore_errors=true);
populate_addrdep_from_csv: insert into addrdep select 0 as _key,_from,_to,maybe from 'out/addr_deps.csv';
populate_inputdep_from_csv: insert into inputdep select 0 as _key,_from,_to,maybe,pos from 'out/input_deps.csv';
backslice: with recursive deps(startIndex, endIndex, path, depth) AS (select _from as startIndex, _to as endIndex, ARRAY[_from] as path, 1 as depth from inputdep where _from == {START_INDEX} UNION ALL SELECT deps.startIndex as startIndex, _to as endIndex, array_append(deps.path, _to) as path, deps.depth + 1 as depth from deps JOIN inputdep ON deps.endIndex == _from WHERE deps.depth < 1000) SELECT startIndex, endIndex, path, depth from deps;
init_accesses: load spatial;create table accesses (pt GEOMETRY, index uint64);
populate_accesses: load spatial;insert into accesses select ST_Point(tick,CASE WHEN opcode == 2 THEN assocd_addr ELSE addr END) as pt,index from operationruns where bank == 1 or opcode == 2;create index access_idx on accesses using RTREE(pt);
get_object_accesses: select count(*) from accesses where ST_Within(pt, ST_MakeEnvelope({START_TICK}, {START_ADDR}, {END_TICK}, {END_ADDR}));
